Each question was evaluated on a 4-point scale ranging from 0 (not at all) to 3 (very much); where higher scores indicate more impact on quality of life. The CDLQI total score was the sum of individual scores of question 1-10 and ranges from 0 (not at all) to 30 (very much): 0-1 = no effect at all on the children's life; 2-6 = small effect on the children's life; 7-12 = moderate effect on the children's life; 13-18 = very large effect on the children's life; 19-30 = extremely large effect on the children's life.
